title: LRU Cache: The Classic Round, Done Senior-Style
instructions: Implement a thread-safe, generic `LRUCache[K, V]` and the frozen `CacheStats` dataclass in `lru.py` with O(1) average operations. Recency is refreshed by `get`, `put` and `get_or_set` but not by `in` or `len`; `get_or_set` runs its factory at most once per missing key; `capacity < 1` raises `ValueError`. Be ready to explain the hash-map-plus-linked-list alternative.

evidence.label: capacity below 1 raises ValueError("capacity must be >= 1")
Evicts the least recently used key when over capacity
Updating an existing key refreshes recency without evicting
A capacity-1 cache evicts on every new key and counts evictions
The in operator does not change recency or hit/miss counts
get returns the default on a miss; stats report hits, misses and are frozen
get_or_set calls the factory once and does not cache failures
get_or_set refreshes recency and counts hits and misses
Concurrent get_or_set calls run the factory exactly once
Eight hammering threads never push the size over capacity
